entities.summary: Anthony Grant Bloom is an English sports gambler, entrepreneur, and poker player. He is the majority owner and chairman of Premier League football club Brighton & Hove Albion, and investor and minority shareholder in Belgian First Division A team Royale Union Saint-Gilloise. He is also a minority owner of Australian A-League club Melbourne Victory and Scottish Premiership club Heart of Midlothian.
